units.title: SG-6.4.2 · Add onReject prop and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
Act: Add onReject prop and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
Verify: ExecutionPanel Reject button unit tests

tests.name: ExecutionPanel Reject button shows Reject for AWAITING_APPROVAL and calls onReject with the id
tests.title: shows Reject for AWAITING_APPROVAL and calls onReject with the id
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution with onReject, when the user clicks Reject, then onReject is called once with 'EX1' and onApprove/onRetry are not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000 -t "shows Reject for AWAITING_APPROVAL"

tests.name: ExecutionPanel Reject button hides Reject without onReject or for non-awaiting statuses
tests.title: hides Reject without onReject or for non-awaiting statuses
tests.scenario: Given AWAITING_APPROVAL without onReject, FAILED with onReject, and RUNNING with onReject, then no Reject button is in the document in each case
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000 -t "hides Reject"

tests.name: ExecutionPanel Reject button Approve and Retry still call their callbacks
tests.title: Approve and Retry still call their callbacks
tests.scenario: Given AWAITING_APPROVAL, when Approve is clicked, then onApprove is called with 'EX1'; given FAILED, when Retry is clicked, then onRetry is called with 'EX1' and onReject is never called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

units.title: REQ · ExecutionPanel shows a Reject button only for AWAITING_APPROVAL runs when onReject is given
Evidence: ExecutionPanel Reject button unit tests
